items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: Oh, I know Wooden Joe, yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, my name, my wife's name, and Paul Dominguez. Paul is dead. We had four pieces there.

One time I saw one picture of a band there, I think Wooden Joe had that picture. Who was that? Wooden Joe Nicholas. Oh, I know Wooden Joe, yeah. With his nephew who was playing, Barney Begard and Nicholas. Albert Nicholas. Albert Nicholas.
Albert Nicholas. They was playing Tom Anderson after we left there.
